meta.source: ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data), acleddata.com

definitions.events: Political violence events: battles, explosions/remote violence, violence against civilians, plus mob violence and excessive force against protesters.
definitions.fatalities: Reported fatalities from those events (ACLED's conservative estimate).
definitions.civEvents: Civilian targeting events: violence against civilians plus explosions/remote violence and mob violence in which civilians were targeted.
definitions.civFatalities: Reported fatalities from civilian targeting events.
definitions.recentEvents: Per local government area: events in each of the last recentMonths months, starting at recentStart (the final month is still being reported).
